summary: June nonfarm payrolls dropped today, released at 8:30 a.m. — the week's defining macro print. Following a hawkish reaction to the Fed's last meeting, investors are watching the report closely for clues on economic strength and whether conditions could support a rate hike this year.
tweet: June payrolls landed today in a holiday-shortened week, with soft ADP and a hawkish Fed framing — equities holding greed while gold and crypto stay in fear.
